tagline: 美能达便携相机，1985 年发布
description: 美能达于1985年推出的便携相机。感光度0,8—5,5 m (wide angle); 0,8—4 m (tele). Warns if subject is out of range.。

specs.感光度: 0,8—5,5 m (wide angle); 0,8—4 m (tele). Warns if subject is out of range.
specs.曝光测光: EV 8.4~18,5 (wide), EV 9.6~19,7 (tele) with ISO100 film. Narrow light metering angle.
specs.英文简介: Dual-lensed compact auto-focus camera launched by Minolta in 1985, offering 38 mm and 60 mm focal lengths.
